description: Exhaustive registry of Granblue Fantasy modals, overlay containers, action buttons, and automated resolution handlers.

modals.name: Stage Quest Category Detail Modal
modals.dismissBehavior: Must dismiss completely before opening another stage card to prevent overlay blockages.

modals.name: Raid Host Treasure Verification Modal
modals.dismissBehavior: Click cancel if materials are insufficient (Held < Required or button disabled). Click offer to confirm.

modals.name: AP Replenishment Modal (Half-Elixir)
modals.dismissBehavior: Select item 1 (Half Elixir) and confirm with .btn-usual-ok.

modals.name: EP Replenishment Modal (Soul Berry)
modals.trigger: Entering multiplayer raid without sufficient EP
modals.dismissBehavior: Select item 2 (Soul Berry / Balm) and confirm with .btn-usual-ok.

modals.name: Arcarum AAP Replenishment Modal
modals.trigger: Entering Replicard Sandbox quest without AAP
modals.dismissBehavior: Consume AAP recovery potion and confirm.

modals.name: Request Backup Modal (Pub)
modals.trigger: Clicking .btn-assist inside active battle (when not on 180s cooldown)
modals.dismissBehavior: Ensure Everyone (all), Friends (friend), and Crew (guild) checkboxes have attribute active='1'. Submit and dismiss confirmation popup.

modals.name: Ascendant Prayer Confirmation Modal
modals.trigger: Launching specific high-level solo/host quests offering prayer buffs

modals.name: Active Raid In-Progress Alert Modal
modals.trigger: Attempting to host or join a quest when an active hosted raid is already live
modals.dismissBehavior: Acknowledge and route to the active raid to resolve it before hosting next raid.

modals.name: Anti-Bot Verification Modal (CAPTCHA)
modals.trigger: Automated behavior flagged by server risk engine
modals.dismissBehavior: HALT automation immediately, ring high-priority sentinel bell, alert operator.
